text:
Try this tonight. Type what you do plus your suburb into your phone. "Plumber Rockingham."

Look at the three businesses on the map. Count their reviews.

40 reviews and two suburbs away? A few months of steady work gets you in the fight.
900 reviews and down the road? Settle in for the year.

Picture a roofer in Melbourne. His SEO is three months in. He's still not on the map.

Phone's quiet.

Google Ads puts him at the top of the page as soon as the ads go live. He pays only when someone clicks.

Run the ads while the map catches up. Then you've got both.

I am so old that I remember when a business put one ad in the Yellow Pages and waited a year for the phone to ring.

Now people search on their phone and pick from the first few names they see.

Your job is to be one of those names. Every week of the year.
